metadata.title: Text Embeddings by Weakly-Supervised Contrastive Pre-training
metadata.year_explanation: The supplied 2024 year is exactly the current arXiv export year and refers to the latest revision. The original work appeared in 2022; the key e52022 is not itself an error. Neither the arXiv record nor the author institution publication page identifies a conference or journal version. Do not invent a published venue or silently treat 2024 as the first-publication year.

uses.reason: Appropriate attribution for E5. The exact v2 checkpoints, 384/768 dimensions and prefixes are corroborated by their primary model cards. The migration, 128-token cap, pinned revisions and experimental procedure are this manuscript's choices, not results established by this citation.
The paper introduces E5 as a text-embedding family with weakly supervised contrastive pre-training, directly supporting the E5 portion of the grouped encoder-family/training attribution.
